notes: «أَبِی ره» opens the chain as the compiler's own father, named only by relation: relation kind, not identified here
«عن آبائه ع» is a collective relation; the Prophet's words that follow are relayed through them, so it is the last link
«[عَنِ]» is an editor's bracket, not a link
The name «علی بن إبراهیم» is as written; the text's spelling is kept
